text: Could you make a clip of a fictional woman standing in a community garden, smiling and turning slightly toward the camera? I like the idea of a garden scene because it reminds me of the little shared garden near where I used to live. To explain the format in the middle of all this, it should be a silent 7-second widescreen clip. The wording should be “Maya Chen” on the first line with “Community Gardener” underneath, at the bottom left from second 1 through the end. Please use white lettering on a dark backing, keep it off her face, and include no other text.
extras: I like the idea of a garden scene because it reminds me of the little shared garden near where I used to live.
